why: One full export of rag_documents_8b costs MORE than the whole daily budget, so it can never be part of the 2026-10-xx nightly contract. Measured 2026-10-23: 1,136,363 points at 24.9 KB/point = 28.3 GB; shards land at 1,243 MB each in 5.1-9.7 min (median 8.3) => 23 shards = ~190 min of pure export+upload. The nightly writer gets 4 x 30 min = 120 min TOTAL for all 98 collections. Including it guarantees the day never completes.

weekly_contract.completion: shard progress accumulates across the 4 firings via expected_shards + per-shard resume; the day is done when len(shards) == expected_shards
